  WHY: The seeder follows the Output Format template verbatim when generating the report. If propagation produces `status=skipped_empty` for a secret — meaning the library secret is unset and the run stays green without copying it — the generated report will not tell the user to add that secret by hand. The user will assume all secrets were copied and leave the consumer without a required secret.
